description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams to set filter parameters specifically for email subscription searches within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It sets a default sort field and specifies allowed sort fields for email subscription filtering.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A class extending FilterParams to provide filtering options specific to email subscriptions in the admin context, including default sorting and allowed sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'emailSubscription.name'.
